title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Haul-Away Allowance Amount
content:
**Allowance clause.** The haul-away allowance of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider is worked out on the rider service request carrying the rider's most recent replacement authorization.

1. The **documented removal cost** is the cost of removing and disposing of the old component, as documented on that request's coverage determination.
2. The **haul-away limit** is the rider's haul-away allowance, as published in the schedule of benefit limits.
3. The **haul-away allowance** is the lowest of the documented removal cost, the haul-away limit, and the rider's term cap less the rider benefit authorized in the current term net of reversals; never below zero, and rounded to the cent.
4. A rider benefit counts as **authorized in the current term** when the whole months from its date to the authorization date are fewer than one more than the whole months from the term start date to the authorization date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider: haul-away allowance USD 100.00 and term cap USD 2000.00 as published)

| Documented removal cost | Rider benefit authorized in the term, net | Term cap room | Haul-away allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 85.00 | 1200.00 | 800.00 | 85.00 |
| 140.00 | 1200.00 | 800.00 | 100.00 |
| 140.00 | 1940.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 |
| 140.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Current-term test (hypothetical dates)

Term start date 1 February; authorization date 10 August. The whole months from 1 February to 10 August are 6, so a benefit counts when the whole months from its date to 10 August are fewer than 7: one dated 15 February (5 whole months) counts.
